messages.author: 38c56d0e82a34280
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] covariate adjustment with MethylKit
parts:
I need to finish properly integrating this into methyKit- ran into some issues with git that I haven't resolved yet. In the meantime, you can source the attached file, diffMethFromDesign. You can then use the function diffMethFromDesign to incorporate any number of covariates in a design matrix and accompanying formula. The last term in the formula is treated as the covariate of interest.

>design=data.frame(gender=c('M','M','M', 'F', 'F','F'), treatment=c(0,1,0,1,0,1))
>formula='gender+treatment'
>num.cores=4
> class(meth)
[1] "methylBase"
attr(,"package")
[1] "methylKit"

myDiff=diffMethFromDesign(meth, design_matrix, formula, num.cores){

Dhruva
